resources.string: Reads screen content to help auto-copy affiliate links and capture product images. Technically this permission can read any foreground app\'s screen, but this app only acts the moment you tap the floating button — it never automatically reads, logs, or uploads content from other apps.
After reaching a Shopee affiliate product\'s share panel, tap the floating button to auto-copy the link and screenshot the product
Allow this app to read Shopee\'s screen content (Shopee only — no other apps are read)
Let the floating capture button appear over the Shopee screen
Running — switch to the Shopee app to start using it
Tap, then switch to the Shopee app to see the floating button
The share panel\'s download button captures the original image — reading the photo library is needed to fetch the file just saved.

Upload automation needs to read each product\'s meta.json under CaptionQueue. Without this permission, regular files like these get blocked by the system (EACCES); video and image access is unaffected.
Choose the Shopee region you use — local-language button text (e.g. share/copy link wording for the Philippines version) will be added automatically to improve detection accuracy
Tap the \"Auto\" button on the floating window from a Shopee product list screen to capture multiple products in a row, based on the settings below, without tapping each one manually
Target count × 6 (at least 30) — prevents endless searching when filters are too strict
Delay Between Steps (random range — larger means slower but less bot-like)
Filter Conditions (leave blank for no limit)
Products that don\'t match will be skipped automatically and not captured
Auto-stops with a clear alert if the target count isn\'t reached in time
Minutes, leave blank for no limit

From the Shopee \"My Likes\" list screen, tap the \"Upload\" button on the floating window to process candidate products in a row (video already generated but not yet posted) — auto-importing the link, picking the video, filling the caption, and publishing
Tap the floating button to capture the current product

Complete these 4 steps in order to auto-generate and post short videos

Automatically turn captured products into short videos

1. Tap the button below to open the Shopee app
2. Search for a product keyword in Shopee
3. A small floating button will appear on screen
4. Tap \"Auto\" on the floating button to keep capturing matching products automatically
